missions.name: Annex a Border Province
missions.text: The Senate judges that a neighboring province would be safer under Roman administration. Take its settlement and the conscript fathers will see your house rewarded.

missions.name: Punish a Defiant City
missions.text: A city has insulted Roman envoys and closed its gates to our merchants. The Senate demands it be brought to heel quickly, before others take courage from its example.

missions.name: Break an Enemy Stronghold
missions.text: From this fortress an enemy of Rome musters armies and plots against the Republic. The Senate charges your house with its capture; the glory and the spoils will be considerable.

missions.name: Secure the Grain Route
missions.text: The city's grain ships pass within sight of a hostile shore, and the mob grows nervous when bread grows dear. Seize the province and put the supply beyond doubt.

missions.name: Strangle Their Harbor
missions.text: An enemy port grows fat on trade that should flow to Roman quays. The Senate wishes its sea lanes closed; a season of blockade will teach the lesson.

missions.name: Court a Useful Friend
missions.text: The Senate sees advantage in friendship with a foreign power whose enemies are our enemies. Send your diplomats and bind them to Rome by treaty.

missions.name: Open the Markets
missions.text: Roman merchants petition the Senate for access to a foreign market now closed to them. Secure trading rights and the grateful publicani will remember your house.

missions.name: Remove a Troublesome King
missions.text: A foreign ruler works ceaselessly against Roman interests, and open war would be costly. The Senate does not put such things in writing; see that the man does not trouble us further.

missions.name: The Senate Demands Your Life
missions.text: Your house has grown too great, and the conscript fathers are afraid. They decree that your patriarch must open his veins for the good of the Republic; refuse, and be named an enemy of Rome.
